summary: Tested Invoice Cancel (API + UI), A4 portrait preview/print, /api/crm-all + localStorage cache instant render (Client & Revenue + GM), and CRM tab colours. Backend 7/7 pytest pass. UI: full flow Save->Submit->Approve (A/E/INV/00053/2627) -> Cancel with empty reason (error toast, unchanged) -> Cancel with reason (Cancelled, number unchanged, inv-cancel-info shown, Edit/Delete disabled). Cancel from Sent (step 4) also works and hides payment box. Register shows Cancelled badge, status filter has Cancelled, KPI 'Total Invoices 0 (+N cancelled)', Total Value excludes cancelled, timeline shows invreg-cancel-reason. Preview iframe: '@page{size:A4 portrait', body 190mm, table 718px within body (no h-overflow), CANCELLED watermark (.cxl); without-company mode has 75mm blank top and no header. Print popup has same A4 portrait CSS + auto print. With /api/crm-all request blocked, /client-revenue and /gm CRM panel still render immediately from ae_crm_cache (no crm-loading). 12 tabs have distinct colours (tint bg + coloured text inactive, solid + white active). All features working; only minor cosmetic issues.

minor.issue: The cancel request takes the whole body, so lines, total, clientId etc. can change in the same call that moves 3/4 -> 6 (and also on 3->4). cancelledAt/cancelledBy come from the client and the server does not set them. Suggestion: when cancelling, keep the existing record and only set step, cancelReason, plus cancelledBy/cancelledAt from the server.

ui_bugs.issue: The .sig cell is 95px high but the 'Designation / Status' div is placed at top:100px. It spills below the table's bottom border (visible in preview).

issues: Step '6. Invoice' sub-line (crm-flow-sub-6) has no Cancelled count. It shows '2 total' with 'Draft 0 · Sub 0 · Appr 0 · Sent 0 · Paid 0', which looks inconsistent.
Item Description column (17%) is narrow, so short descriptions wrap to 3 lines while IGST/CGST/SGST columns are mostly empty. Consider a wider description column.

action_items: (Low) Fix the signature block overflow in buildInvoiceHtml: raise .sig height to about 115px or lower the div tops.
(Low) Add the Cancelled count to the crm-flow-sub-6 sub-line.
(Low) On server-side cancel, change only the cancel fields and set cancelledBy/cancelledAt on the server.
critical_code_review_comments: Logout removes ae_crm_cache (store.js:1217). Good, cached CRM data does not leak to the next user.
The crmCache module object stays in memory after logout without a page reload. crmCacheReady() checks localStorage, so this is safe.
The cancel rule check for old_step==6 runs before the power check, so a non-admin gets 400 instead of 403 on a cancelled invoice. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: TEST_cl1 client plus TEST invoices were created and then fully cleaned up in Mongo (crm_invoices by clientId TEST_cl1, crm_clients TEST_*). inv_2627/invref_2627 counters were unset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter41_invoice_cancel.py creates TEST_cl1 and TEST_inv41* invoices. Cancelled/numbered ones cannot be deleted via the API, so after running: mongosh vendor_management --eval 'db.crm_invoices.deleteMany({clientId:"TEST_cl1"});db.crm_clients.deleteMany({id:/^TEST_/});db.counters.updateOne({key:"crm"},{$unset:{inv_2627:"",invref_2627:""}})'. CrmActionBar testids are inv-btn-save/submit/approve/edit/delete and the status is inv-bar-status. Cancel uses window.prompt.
